description: This file defines the EmployeeTrackerAPI class within the OrangeHRM system. It provides REST API endpoints for managing employee performance trackers, including listing, retrieving specific entries, and related search/filter functionalities. It incorporates annotations for API documentation and utilizes various traits and dependencies related to performance tracking and user roles.
